notes: V3 (2026-10-29). Printed: 'Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Then that creature deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control.' 'its power' is the Bear's (2 + the counter = 3), not the Giant's 4, so the 4/4 Giant survives with 3 damage. Before the fix the amount read the second target's power and the Giant died. tools/scenarios/hunters_edge.json could not tell (both creatures end at power 3).
